title: Meeting transcripts and conversation intelligence
for: meeting transcripts, call summaries, action items into memory/transcripts/inbox/

manual.export: Open the meeting in the tool, copy or download the transcript as text, and save it as one Markdown file per meeting in the inbox contract (memory/transcripts/README.md) with the date and a slug in the filename.

vendors.name: Granola
caveats: OAuth-only, so the MCP cannot run headless; scripts/pull_transcripts.py carries the unattended daily pull
Paid Granola plans only
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

vendors.name: Gong
caveats: Three tools (ask_account, ask_deal, generate_brief) return AI-generated insights over a time range; the server does not hand back raw transcripts, so the inbox pull needs the Gong REST API in a script
A Gong technical admin creates the MCP integration (Company Settings > Ecosystem > API > Integrations > Create Integration > MCP) and issues the client id and secret used in the OAuth flow
Not in the Claude connectors directory; add as a custom connector
Community server cedricziel/gong-mcp reads calls and transcripts with GONG_ACCESS_KEY and GONG_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET; judge it as a script, not a vendor tool

auth.where: browser grant with the client id and secret a Gong admin created for MCP

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; the API access key pair (Company Settings > Ecosystem > API) reads /v2/calls/transcript into the inbox with source: gong

vendors.name: Fireflies.ai
caveats: OAuth-only; a scheduled inbox pull uses the GraphQL API with an API key
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; the API key (Settings > Developer settings) queries the GraphQL transcripts endpoint into the inbox with source: fireflies

vendors.name: Fathom
caveats: OAuth-only; a scheduled inbox pull uses the REST API with an API key
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; the API key (Settings > API) reads /external/v1/meetings with transcripts into the inbox with source: fathom

vendors.name: Otter.ai
caveats: OAuth with per-meeting permissions; read-only
The endpoint is known from the Claude connector listing, not an Otter developer page; confirm before wiring
No public API for a scheduled pull; the manual export is the unattended route

vendors.name: Grain
caveats: OAuth through the Claude Integrations flow; read-only, with built-in report prompts
A scheduled inbox pull uses the Grain public API with a personal access token

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; a personal access token (Settings > Integrations > Public API) reads /_/public-api/recordings into the inbox with source: grain

vendors.name: Avoma
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__avoma`) until checked
Avoma says the server is supported only with Claude Desktop, and the user guide does not print an endpoint URL; no .mcp.json entry until a person reads it from the guide while signed in
Writes classify meetings and log outcomes

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; the API key (Settings > Integrations > API) reads /v1/transcriptions into the inbox with source: avoma

vendors.name: tl;dv
caveats: Local server only (tldv-public/tldv-mcp-server, 14 stars, last push 2025-12-12); the repo's package.json declares no bin and the npm package `tldv-mcp` carries no repository link, so no pinned stdio entry could be written; clone the repo and run it from a built checkout if wanted
Reads across Meet, Zoom and Teams recordings with a tl;dv API key
Low maintenance activity; judge as a script

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; the API key (Settings > API) reads /v1alpha1/meetings and transcripts into the inbox with source: tldv

vendors.name: Zoom
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__zoom`) until checked

Zoom publishes several servers: /mcp/zoom/streamable (workspace), /mcp/meeting/streamable, /mcp/docs/streamable, /mcp/chat/streamable, /mcp/tasks/streamable; the meeting server is wired here for transcripts and summaries
Auth and admin requirements are not in the registry metadata; verify in the Zoom App Marketplace before wiring
Not in the Claude connectors directory
The unattended inbox pull is a Server-to-Server OAuth app, as the worked example in integrations/adding-an-integration.md describes

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; a Server-to-Server OAuth app (Zoom App Marketplace) reads /v2/users/me/recordings and the transcript files into the inbox with source: zoom

vendors.name: Google Meet (Gemini notes via Workspace MCP)
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__google-workspace`) until checked
Public Developer Preview; a Workspace admin must allow-list the MCP client
Meet transcripts and Gemini notes live as Drive documents, so the server reads them through Drive and Docs tools, not a Meet-specific tool
Community alternative aaronsb/google-workspace-mcp; judge it as a script

auth.where: Google account browser grant, after the Workspace admin allow-lists the client

script.notes: copy scripts/pull_transcripts.py; a service account with domain-wide delegation lists the Meet Recordings folder through the Drive API and exports each notes doc into the inbox with source: googlemeet
